'''Turnip seeds''' can be planted using the [[Cultivator]] in order to grow 1x [[Turnip]].


== Availability ==
* Turnip seeds can be found in the [[Swamp]] by harvesting their flowers. Picked seeds do not respawn.
* Due to Swamps being mostly covered in water, turnip seeds are considerably harder to find than carrot seeds. The water causes turnip seeds to generate less frequently. <!--This feels more like a note-->
* Three turnip seeds can be obtained by planting a [[Turnip]] using the [[Cultivator]] option "Seed-turnip".

== Notes ==
* It takes between 4,000 seconds and 5,000 seconds (between 66 minutes 40 seconds and 83 minutes 20 seconds, or about 2.22-2.78 in-game days) for them to fully grow.

Purchase items from traders | weight = 0.1 | stack = 999 | teleport = Yes }} '''Coins''' are a material item found in all [[biomes]] that are mainly used to trade. Coins can be acquired by killing [[Troll]], [[Fuling]], [[Fuling Shaman]], [[Fuling Berserker]] or [[Dvergr (race)|Dvergr]], looting [[Loot chest|chests]], and looting [[dungeon]]s and some other [[point of interest|points of interest]]. They can also be obtained by selling items with the "[[Valuables|Valuable]]" quality to traders, such as [[Ruby]], [[Amber]], [[Amber Pearl]] and [[Silver Necklace]]. 1000 coins can be converted instantly into 100 [[Coal]]s, using the [[Obliterator]]. Alternatively, the player can buy 2000 [[Bait]]s for 1000 coins from [[Haldor]], and turn them into 200 coals using the Obliterator. == Usage == * Used to purchase items from traders like, [[Haldor]], [[Hildir]], and [[The Bog Witch]]. === Building === * {{item link|Treasure chest}} * {{item link|Coin Stack}} * {{item link|Coin Pile}} {{MaterialsNav}} [[cs:Mince]] [[ru:Монеты]] [[uk:Монети]] [[de:Münzen]] [[fr:Piastres]]

'''Lox Saddle''' is a craftable item.

Lox Saddles grant the ability to ride tamed [[Lox]]. To attach, simply put the saddle on the hotbar then activate while aimed at a tamed [[Lox]]. The saddle can then be "teleported" to, like a boat rudder, by pressing the "Use" key (E by default). The saddle can be removed from the Lox by pressing Left-Shift + E.

This should be kept warm. | id = AsksvinEgg | type = Material | source = [[Asksvin]] | usage = [[Taming]] | weight = 1.0 | stack = 20 | teleport = Yes }} Asksvin eggs are laid by [[Asksvin]] in the [[Ashlands]] [[Biomes|biome]]. See [[Asksvin#Breeding|Asksvin - Breeding]] for more details. == Hatching == When placed near a fire or heat source for 30 minutes, the egg will hatch and an [[Asksvin|Asksvin hatchling]] will spawn, which will then grow into an adult [[Asksvin]]. The egg must be individual - not in a stack - in order to hatch. Unlike [[Egg|chicken eggs]], Asksvin eggs come in different qualities. The number (quality) at the top right of the icon notes the level (stars) of the hatchling:
Quality "1" hatches into regular Askvin hatchlings
Quality "2" hatches into 1-star Askvin hatchlings
Quality "3" hatches into 2-star Askvin hatchlings. [[ru:Яйцо пеплозавра]]

The '''Hooded Lantern''' exists both as a placeable structure and as a handheld item.

== Building ==
The Hooded Lantern is found in the Misc category of the [[Hammer]] and does not require a crafting station. Unlike most structures, it can also be placed inside dungeons. It costs:
* {{Item link|Timberwood|3}}
* {{Item link|Luminous Larva|1}}

It has 100 durability. It is resistant to pierce, fire, frost and lightning damage, weak to chop damage, and immune to poison and spirit damage. It does not need fuel. Its light is a spotlight with a 30° cone and a range of 30 meters, aimed in one direction, together with a point light with a range of two meters.

== Item ==
The handheld Hooded Lantern is a torch-type item. Equipping it reduces movement speed by 5%. It has no durability. It can be used to block, with a block armor of 3, a block force of 20 and a parry bonus of 2x.
